title: Change
description: One entry of the change feed.

seq.description: Node-wide monotonically increasing sequence number of this entry (snapshot entries carry the object's latest seq).

type.description: Object type. Consumers MUST ignore entries with unknown types.

op.description: upsert: the object is visible to you with this current state. delete: tombstone, the object is no longer visible to you (deleted, unpublished, parent hidden, outside grant, rights expired).

updated_at.description: upsert: the object's updated_at. delete: when it stopped being visible.

data.description: Present on upsert (never on delete): the CURRENT representation (Brand, Product without variants/assets, Variant, Asset or Grant according to type).

resync.description: Only on type=grant: true when your visible set changed; restart /changes without a cursor (full snapshot) and sweep.
